_comment: Contract registry for StonkFlyRH. Copy to tokens.json.
The Uniswap addresses below are Robinhood Chain (4663) deployments as listed in
Uniswap's own deployment records (github.com/Uniswap/contracts, deployments/4663.md,
and sdk-core's CHAIN_TO_ADDRESSES_MAP), which agree with each other. USDG is the
address Blockscout lists for Global Dollar. They were NOT confirmed against the
chain from inside this repository: run `python -m stonkflyrh chain verify` before
any run. It refuses an address with no code, a router and quoter that disagree
about their factory, a token whose on-chain symbol or decimals differ from this
file, and any pair with no pool at its fee tier. Check them on
robinhoodchain.blockscout.com yourself as well.
The quote asset is USDG (6 decimals — verify confirms). Every memecoin is traded
Memecoin seeds are optional: leave 'tokens' empty and discovery fills the universe
from new USDG pools. To seed one, add: "PONS": {"address": "0x...", "decimals": 18,
"pool_fee": 10000} and list it in STONKFLYRH_PRODUCTS. pool_fee is the Uniswap v3 tier.
The 'v4' block is where launchpad tokens live: Pons graduates every token into a
Uniswap v4 pool behind its hook. hooks_allow lists hooks whose pools discovery may
admit; the Pons V2 hook is pre-filled. Addresses are from Uniswap's sdk-core map and
Pons's docs; `chain verify` confirms each holds code.
'bridges' names assets with a USDG v4 pool the fly may route THROUGH to reach a
token paired with them (a coin launched against GOOGL, say). Give the USDG pool's
PoolKey. Hookless standard-fee USDG pools seen on chain are learned as bridges too.

bridges._comment: fill in the GOOGL/USDG v4 PoolKey; currencies sorted ascending
